notes.title: Notes
notes.n1: Proposal is only applied for high performance individual only — chỉ áp dụng cho NV hiệu suất cao.
notes.n2: Frequency is every Apr/Oct and finalize the evaluation about 1 month earlier — đợt tháng 4 & 10.
notes.n3: Promotion level by level, don't jump over levels — thăng từng bậc, không nhảy bậc.
notes.n4: Promotion but the job scale remains the same, please provide clear explanation why promotion needed.
